newsitem.title: USA: WellPoint to buy Hancock unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: WellPoint to buy Hancock unit - WSJ.

text.p: WellPoint Health Networks Inc will soon close talks with John Hancock Life Insurance Co to buy most or all of Hancock's health-insurance operations, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
Citing sources close to the negotiations, the newspaper said the purchase would add about two million people to the 4.3 million who already get health care services from WellPoint.
Although the sale price was not known, it said Hancock's annual premiums from its group insurance unit totalled $870 million last year.
Talks between WellPoint and Hancock began "several months ago," it added.
Both companies declined to comment to Reuters on a similar report published in the Boston Globe daily newspaper, saying only that the deal could still fall through.
